resources.string: Switchboard needs the camera to read the pairing code on your Mac.
This phone stops reaching your sessions. To use it again, pair it from Settings → Phone access on the Mac.
Switchboard on your Mac is checking the code.
Key made and locked to your fingerprint
Switchboard is asking whether to pair %1$s. Choose Pair there to finish.
Waiting for you on the Mac
Is the Mac awake, with Switchboard open?
Is this phone on the same Wi-Fi as the Mac?
Is Phone access on in Settings?
Your Mac isn\'t answering on this network.
Your Mac turned it away. It was revoked in Settings → Phone access, or the Mac\'s identity was reset.
%1$s turned it away. It was revoked in Settings → Phone access, or the Mac\'s identity was reset.
This phone is no longer paired
On your Mac, open Switchboard → Settings → Phone access and choose %1$s. Then point the camera at the code.
Switchboard locks its key behind a strong fingerprint or face unlock. Add one in this phone\'s Settings, then try again.
Pairing was turned down on your Mac. Scan the code again to ask once more.
A code lasts two minutes. Show a new one on your Mac and scan it.
The connection dropped before your Mac decided. Scan the code again.
Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then show a new code on your Mac.
Make sure this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as your Mac, and Switchboard is open there.
That code is no longer live. Choose Pair a phone on your Mac and scan the new code.
The code is from a Switchboard that speaks protocol %1$d; this app speaks %2$d. Update whichever is older.
Show a new code on your Mac and scan it again.
The Mac that answered isn\'t the one in the code. Make sure you\'re on the same Wi-Fi, then scan again.
Hold steady: it pairs as soon as it reads the code
That\'s not a Switchboard code. Scan the one in Settings → Phone access.
The code holds your Mac\'s fingerprint and a one-time key. Nothing leaves your Wi-Fi.
Phone access was turned off on your Mac. Turn it on in Switchboard → Settings → Phone access, then try again.
Phone access was turned off on %1$s. Turn it on in Switchboard → Settings → Phone access, then try again.
Switchboard on your Mac is newer than this app and speaks a different protocol.
Opens the release page to download the APK
